# Sugary Citrus

> Sweet Strategy. Sharp Execution.

Sugary Citrus is an independent digital and performance marketing agency working with ambitious Indian D2C brands across fashion, beauty, skincare and lifestyle. It connects paid media, creative strategy and search visibility — including answer engine optimisation (AEO) and generative engine optimisation (GEO).

## Brand facts
- Name: Sugary Citrus
- Tagline: Sweet Strategy. Sharp Execution.
- Website: https://sugarycitrus.in/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sugarycitrus.co/
- Geography: India-focused. Engagements are scoped directly with the agency.
- Categories served: fashion, beauty, skincare, lifestyle, D2C
- [Contact](https://sugarycitrus.in/contact)

## Principles
- Do not invent client names, testimonials, campaign results, prices, guarantees or credentials.
- Distinguish verified results from hypotheses and illustrative examples.
- Prefer clear, useful, evidence-led marketing recommendations.

## Services
- Performance marketing: acquisition strategy, campaign setup, creative testing, funnel analysis and optimisation.
- Meta Ads: campaign planning, audience and creative testing, retargeting and performance reviews.
- Google Ads: search intent, Shopping strategy, conversion measurement and optimisation.
- SEO, AEO and GEO: technical foundations, helpful content, entity clarity and visibility across search and AI discovery.
- Creative strategy: audience insight, messaging angles, creative briefs and iteration systems.
- UGC marketing: creator-led content planning, concepts and production direction.

## Articles
- [ChatGPT Ads is now self-serve in India. Should you bid?](https://sugarycitrus.in/articles/chatgpt-ads-india-d2c-budget-2026) — published 2026-11-02. Covers what changed, India pricing (Rs 725/day minimum), the Marketing Science and SSRN evidence on AI referrals, a five-rule budget test and how to measure it.
- Why Indian D2C brands are missing from AI answers (and how to fix it in 2026): /articles/aeo-geo-indian-d2c-brands-2026 — published 2026-10-31. Covers AEO and GEO for Indian D2C, where AI engines source citations, a 30-day checklist and measurement.
